readerNotes.line: In the west the ticked line meets the heavy east west army group boundary near 5.21E 50.16N; the heavy unticked line running west from there is the boundary and was not counted. North end where the heavy line comes down near the Maas at about 5.84E; the Westwall hatching near Aachen was not used. The south east end leaves the east edge near Saarlautern; a heavy line running south from there toward Metz looks like a boundary and was not followed. Line thinned to 38 points.
